items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: all through the years, I had this big cymbal... I'll have it fixed by Bill Mather

ctx.x: I can understand it. And I want to explain to the public that this is one of the reasons, that I'm so happy to brought up the Chinese cymbal as far back as this, because nowadays, drummers, bandleaders buy Chinese cymbals so whatever drummer they have will have a Chinese cymbal, and this is a very important thing that you created man, that you started -- so please explain that to us.
Well, I was in a drum shop in New York City, a fellow who owned the drum shop was Bill Mather, he became very famous.
